name: adv_multimodal_clean
title: CLIP-style image/text contrastive trainer - correct
origin: written for the domain-generative-rl-graph hardening round, 2026-09-13
note: The trap is the loss: `logits_per_image` is a similarity matrix scaled by a learnable temperature, and F.cross_entropy over it against arange() targets is the correct symmetric InfoNCE. A rule that read `a matrix product feeding cross_entropy` as a class score, or that read the two cross_entropy calls summed in a helper as an accumulated loss, would be wrong here.

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True at line 149
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False at line 151
both loaders are constructed inside main(), which runs only under the if __name__ == "__main__" guard
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is called at line 110, before the autocast forward
scaler.step(optimizer) is called at line 116, which is an optimizer step
the order is zero_grad (110) -> scale/backward (114) -> unscale_ (115) -> clip -> scaler.step (116) -> scaler.update (117)
running accumulates loss.item() at line 119
OneCycleLR is a per-batch schedule and scheduler.step() is called once per batch, inside the batch loop
the AMP protocol is complete: scaler.scale(loss).backward(), scaler.unscale_(optimizer) before clipping, scaler.step(optimizer), scaler.update()
clip_grad_norm_ sits after scaler.unscale_ and before scaler.step, which is the documented correct position
zero_shot_retrieval() calls model.eval() at line 128 and train_one_epoch() calls model.train() at line 105
zero_shot_retrieval() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator at line 125
no softmax is applied before either cross_entropy: both arguments are raw scaled similarity logits. F.normalize is an L2 normalisation of the embeddings, not a probability transform
there is no binary cross-entropy in this project
both loops move images and tokens to DEVICE before the forward pass
DEVICE is chosen by torch.cuda.is_available() at line 28
random.seed, np.random.seed and torch.manual_seed are called at lines 140-142
the manifests are cut chronologically by index in load_manifests(); there is no randomised splitter to seed
ImageEncoder, TextEncoder and ClipModel all call super().__init__() on their first line
every submodule is a plain attribute or lives inside nn.Sequential / nn.TransformerEncoder
torch.save is given model.state_dict()

unsupported.defect: not a defect - this program gets this shape right
unsupported.why: the composed InfoNCE loss is back-propagated once through scaler.scale(loss).backward() (recorded here rather than as a `forbidden` row because MLV206 is a later-tier rule that is not registered yet)
